name: NavAppModuleInfo Main
brief: Consuming bundle of the per-module NavApp.GetCurrentModuleInfo reproducer: asserts the dep sees its own identity (25.8.43.0) while the bundle sees its own (1.0.0.0).
description: Companion of navapp-moduleinfo-dep. Proves per-emitted-assembly module identity: GetCurrentModuleInfo inside the dependency returns the dep's name/version, GetCurrentModuleInfo here returns this bundle's, GetCallerModuleInfo inside the dep names this bundle, and GetModuleInfo(depId) resolves the registered dep by AppId.
